summary: Louis Miller, 52, Eldora Mountain Resort staff member, struck by a falling tree while assisting with post-season trail maintenance on Thursday morning; died on scene despite immediate ski-patrol care and rapid Flight for Life response; not suspicious (BCSO 24-02368)
responding_agency: Boulder County Sheriff's Office; Boulder County Coroner's Office; Nederland Fire Protection District; American Medical Response; Flight for Life Colorado
notes: Workplace tree-felling accident during maintenance (ski season ended April 21); indexed on the multi-agency emergency response + coroner investigation, cf. id-3264 in-bounds precedent.
